text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Feb ●, Noon | Wind: Refreshing "I'll show 
ya some real big treasure!" 
========================================

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
A boring rumor reached my ears—that "only 
those with rich families can challenge 
overseas." Is there anything more pathetic 
than that?

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Dreams come true. If you try, you can do 
it. I'll make you believe in obvious 
truths like that!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I invited Hishi Miracle, 
telling her: 'I'm gonna run even faster 
than Silence Suzuka's record at the Kinko 
Sho. Come watch!'"

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Once we win the Kinko Sho, it's finally 
time for the real deal—the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe! Let's take all our friends 
and head to France!
